articles.title: Bitcoin slides to 3-month low of $65,000 as analyst flags fourth capitulation wave
articles.snippet: "They are now selling at the very price they wish they had taken advantage of three months ago," wrote James Check.

articles.title: Kazakhstan plans tokenized government bonds in first quarter after $22 million note sale
articles.snippet: The plan follows Kazakhstan's first sale of tokenized central bank notes as the country expands its crypto market.

articles.title: Britain could turn wasted Scottish wind power into bitcoin to cut its $1.3 billion grid bill
articles.snippet: Britain could use bitcoin mining to absorb surplus Scottish wind power and reduce payments to wind farms to halt generation, according to a Bitcoin Policy Institute report.

articles.title: A behind the scenes force may amplify bitcoin and ether price volatility
articles.snippet: Both bitcoin and ether are trading in price ranges where market makers and dealers may add to market volatility.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
articles.snippet: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world’s bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec. 31, 2027. Paraguay’s state utility calls the date final, and it has just signed a 15-year deal to power a Founders Fund-backed AI campus.
